label: SMOKE fixture — CNN fact check
summary: CNN noted that the 9.1% year-over-year rate in June 2022 was a 40-year high, not the all-time record; the all-time record cited was 23.7% in 1920. Cumulative inflation during Biden's presidency was about 21%, versus about 49% during Jimmy Carter's term.
title: Fact check: Debunking 100 Trump false claims from his first 100 days
